examples.arabic: في السوق جدتي كانت فرحانة بالخضار الفريش والأسعار الرخيصة اوي
examples.english: At the market, my grandmother was very happy with the fresh vegetables and very cheap prices.
examples.transliteration: Fi es souq geddeti kanet farhana bel khodar el fresh wel as'ar el rekheesa awi

examples.arabic: الجدة فضلت تسأل عن الاسعار وتتكلم مع البياعين كتير وتقول اهلا بيكي لكل ست بتقابلها
examples.english: The grandmother kept asking about prices and talking a lot with the sellers, saying "Ahlan beeki" to every woman she met
examples.transliteration: El-gedda faddalet tes'al 'an el-as'ar we tetkallem ma' el-bayya'een kiteer we te'ul "Ahlan beeki" le koll sett bet'abelha

examples.arabic: امي بتحب تتكلم مع البياعين عشان تعرف احسن الاسعار
examples.english: My mom likes to talk with the sellers to know the best prices.
examples.transliteration: Ommy betehebb titkallem ma'a el bayya'een 'ashaan ta'raf ahsan el as'aar
examples.storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market
